title: One Pace
subtitle: One Piece at the manga's pacing
blurb: 474 episodes, 36 arcs, no filler and no padding.
notes: A fan re-edit of the One Piece anime cut down to the manga's pacing — filler removed, padding trimmed. The same story as the One Piece tracker here, in roughly a third of the runtime.
One Pace numbers each arc from 1 rather than running a continuous count, so the episode numbers here restart in every section, exactly as the releases do.

Arc order, names, the manga chapters each covers and the anime episodes each replaces are read from the official watch page at onepace.net. Wano and Egghead are still being released and their counts will grow.
